name: Wilson Dam
note: Dickey County park on the south-west shore of Wilson Dam reservoir, about 7.5 miles west of Monango: camping is on a mown lawn inside two tree rows beside the picnic shelter, with no gravel pads seen on imagery and the number of electric sites unpublished. Pay by check to Dickey County Park at the lockbox on either utility pole (park board at extension 3). --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Dickey County Park Board page (dickeynd.com/park-board, read 2026-11-12) names Wilson Dam one of the county's 2 county parks, 'open to the public', '11.8 miles north of Ellendale on highway 281 and approximately 7.4 miles west on county road 86th St SE. The camping is on a first come first serve basis. Camping using electrical site is $20/night; Camping not using electrical - primitive - is $10/night (Make checks payable to Dickey County Park to be placed in lockbox located on either utility pole)', plus shelter, 2 grills, playground, boat ramp, 1 accessible + 2 vault restrooms; park board phone 701-349-3249 ext. 3 -> a county-designated, fee-charging camping area with electric sites, not a bare open-space allowance (contrast Pheasant Lake 6047 on the same page, 'Primitive camping is allowed in open spaces'). Not on the ND HHS licensed RV park list (07.17.2025; Dickey County lists only Huebner Trailer Park and Trinity Bible College). Nominatim/OSM: reservoir 46.17649,-98.75230, dam 46.17497,-98.75038; Google 'Wilson Dam' is the water feature at 46.17219,-98.74982 (no phone, no reviews), in the field south of the access road. Esri + USGS NAIP imagery: gravel access road from the section-line road on the west, a mown lawn in a V of tree rows with the shelter, a vault toilet and a playground/fire-ring cluster, vehicle tracks across the lawn, gravel road to a point and a ramp/dock; open grass, no visible pads, so pad size unpublished (keep with caveat). No horse facilities or mention anywhere; no 4WD/road warning. Public (county): no price gate or presence rule.
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-12: Esri World Imagery (320 m frame at 46.1756,-98.7540 and z19 tiles at 46.1752,-98.7546) plus USGS NAIP: the only identifiable camping area is the mown lawn inside a V of continuous tree rows, with the shelter, toilet and playground; the north-east tree row and the V's apex screen it from the reservoir's west arm, and from the lawn's open south end the south cove's marshy edge is ~90 m east across open grass and the gravel ramp road. No pads, pedestals or parked RVs are visible anywhere and no site map exists, so no site is proven on or overlooking the water -> default down to not waterfront. Below-the-dam check: the earthen dam runs along the reservoir's east/south-east side (OSM dam node 46.17497,-98.75038); the campground is ~350 m west of its south end on the upstream (reservoir) side, Open-Meteo DEM 494-496 m on the lawn vs 491 m on open water, so it is above pool, not below the dam.
fees_source: https://dickeynd.com/park-board (read 2026-11-12): electrical site $20/night, primitive (not using electrical) $10/night, checks to Dickey County Park in the lockbox on either utility pole
flags: Lawn camping: the county page designates camping with electric sites and fees, but imagery shows only a mown lawn (no pads) and the number of electric sites is unpublished; added as county-designated camping, not an allowance. AWH may prefer a call to the park board (701-349-3249 ext. 3) to confirm the hookup count.
FCFS is stated only in the note; no booking group written (result shape has none for FCFS).

Waterfront set not waterfront by default-down; the lawn's south end may see the south cove ~90 m east across grass and the ramp road, and the open grass between the NE tree row and the ramp road is ~40-60 m from water, but no camping there is evidenced. Lakeview if a source ever places sites there.
Not on the ND HHS licensed list (07.17.2025).
Google's point 46.1722,-98.7498 is the water feature, in a field south of the access road; pinned at the camping lawn by the shelter instead.
